name: app.vercel.warstwa-omega/mcp
title: Warstwa: katalog sklepu
description: Read-only catalogue of Warstwa: 3D-printed desk accessories, PLN prices, help.

tools.name: search_products
tools.description: Use first when a person describes what they need for their desk. Searches the Warstwa catalogue of 3D-printed desk accessories (Polish product names, diacritics optional) and returns matching products with PLN price, colours and page links.

query.description: Keywords in Polish or product terms, e.g. 'podstawka telefon', 'kable', 'słuchawki'

limit.description: Maximum number of products to return (default 10)

tools.name: get_product
tools.description: Use after search_products to answer detailed questions about one product. Returns description, material, dimensions in mm, weight, print time, colours, variants with their PLN prices and personalisation limits.

tools.name: get_pricing
tools.description: Use to compare prices or answer cost questions. Returns every product's starting price in PLN plus the shop policy: shipping cost, free-shipping threshold, set discount, made-to-order and the 14-day withdrawal rule.

tools.name: search_help
tools.description: Use for questions about personalisation, printing, shipping, materials or care. Searches the shop's own help answers (Polish) and returns question/answer pairs; unanswered questions are never returned, so do not guess beyond them.
